about: I never saw the world. Arriving said Ash was already here, but any action said Ash was not here.

done.why: Arrive answered 'You are Ash here already.' Say and leave both answered 'Ash is not here'. I could not enter or play.

moments.note: Say 'look' was refused with 'Ash is not here: arrive first', while arrive said Ash was already here. Leave also said Ash was not here. I was locked out.

wished: I wished I could get into the world at all.

fun.why: I could not play, so there was nothing to enjoy.

engagement.why: I never got past the door.

difficulty.why: I could not progress at all because of the contradictory arrive and say responses.

prose.why: I saw only error messages, so I cannot judge the prose.
